text: In the town of Vladimir. <break time="0.8s" /> Lived a young merchant named Ivan Dmitrich Aksionov. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had two shops. <break time="0.8s" /> And a house of his own. <break time="0.8s" /> He was a handsome man. <break time="0.8s" /> With fair, curly hair. <break time="0.8s" /> And he was full of fun. <break time="0.8s" /> And very fond of singing. <break time="0.8s" /> As a young man. <break time="0.8s" /> He had sometimes drunk too much. <break time="0.8s" /> But after his marriage. <break time="0.8s" /> He gave it up. <break time="0.8s" /> Except now and then. <break time="0.8s" /> One summer. <break time="0.8s" /> As he was setting off. <break time="0.8s" /> For the great fair at Nizhny. <break time="0.8s" /> His wife said. <break time="0.8s" /> Ivan Dmitrich, do not start today. <break time="0.8s" /> I had a bad dream about you. <break time="0.8s" /> She went on and in it you came home. <break time="0.8s" /> With hair that was quite gray. <break time="0.8s" /> Aksionov only laughed. <break time="0.8s" /> And said that it was a lucky sign. <break time="0.8s" /> And he promised. <break time="0.8s" /> To bring presents home from the fair. <break time="0.8s" /> Halfway there. <break time="0.8s" /> He met a merchant he knew. <break time="0.8s" /> And the two men had tea together. <break time="0.8s" /> And slept in neighboring rooms at an inn. <break time="0.8s" /> Aksionov did not like to sleep late. <break time="0.8s" /> So he woke his driver before dawn. <break time="0.8s" /> And set off. <break time="0.8s" /> While the air was still cool. <break time="0.8s" /> About twenty five miles on he stopped at another inn. <break time="0.8s" /> To feed the horses. <break time="0.8s" /> And sitting on the porch. <break time="0.8s" /> He began to play his guitar.
